# The event URL helper receives undefined from its optional-chain caller

An absent normal-item URL property returns null; the edit caller's optional trim produces undefined. updateItemURL handles that value with its falsy visibility check and early return. Its adopted {?string} annotation does not name this actual undefined input. A local documentation correction can describe that input or normalize the caller without implying a runtime failure. For a present URL, the function returns before its timer assigns the link attributes, so invocation is not a synchronous completed-link guarantee.

Scope: Calendar event URL JSDoc and completion scope.
